overview_description.description:
Flynas is an airline that offers a network of domestic and international flights across the Middle East, Asia, Europe, and Africa. The airline's primary hubs include King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, King Abdulaziz International Airport in Jeddah, King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, and Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Madinah. 

Since its inception, Flynas has transported over 80 million passengers. The airline has received several accolades, including being ranked as the world's 4th best low-cost airline for two consecutive years and the best in the Middle East for seven years in a row (2017-2023) by Skytrax. Additionally, Flynas has been recognized as the Middle East's Leading Low-Cost Airline by the World Travel Awards for ten consecutive years (2015-2024).
